name: SEO Macroscope
why: Desktop crawler that audits a site's pages, links and metadata.
coreLoopCovered: Technical crawl of a site you control. No rank tracking and no backlink or keyword database.

name: SEOnaut
why: Self-hosted SEO auditing tool that crawls a site and reports issues.
coreLoopCovered: Site crawl with an issue list and page reports. No rank tracking and no backlink data.

name: SerpBear
why: Self-hosted keyword position tracker that reads results through a scraping or SERP API and Search Console.
coreLoopCovered: Daily keyword rank tracking for your own domain. No crawl, no backlink data, no competitor database.

name: OpenSEO
why: Open-source SEO tool for keyword research and rank tracking that can be self-hosted.
coreLoopCovered: Keyword research and tracking driven by a paid data API. No own web index or backlink crawl.

name: Unlighthouse
why: Tool that runs Lighthouse across every page of a site and reports performance and SEO scores.
coreLoopCovered: Site-wide Lighthouse audits for your own site. No rank tracking, no backlinks, no keyword data.

name: advertools
why: Python library for crawling sites, parsing sitemaps and logs, and analysing search ads and keywords.
coreLoopCovered: Scriptable crawling, sitemap and log analysis for your own site. A library, not a dashboard; no backlink data.
